title: Can LLMs Simulate L2-English Dialogue? An Information-Theoretic Analysis of L1-Dependent Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to simulate L2 English speakers with specific native first language (L1) backgrounds and comparing their generated dialogues to human L2 learner data (ICNALE dataset) using information-theoretic metrics and distributional density measures across eight linguistic features (e.g., tense agreement, noun-verb collocations, speech acts).
